findings.check: Defects are in the WF-03 format (severity/status line)
findings.title: 11 defect files have the severity line with extra words or split over two lines
findings.evidence: Regex «Серьёзность: (LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL). Статус: (\w+)» fails on these; e.g. ISS-0005:3 «Серьёзность: MEDIUM (если повторится); сейчас не воспроизведён — под наблюдением.» and status on line 4; ISS-0081:3 «Серьёзность: LOW, при решении о публикации — MEDIUM.» A looser count still finds the severity word first, so the totals agree with STATE.md (77 open: 9 MEDIUM, 68 LOW).
findings.recommendation: Keep the strict form «Серьёзность: X. Статус: Y.» and move the explanations into a sentence after it, so that counting by a command stays reliable.
